name: The Crown & The Flame
source:
Your enemies stole your kingdom, but now the time has come for you to raise an army, master magic, and reclaim your crown!

- Form alliances to build your army.
- Master unique weapons.
- Choose between elegant ball gowns and powerful armor.
- Crush your enemies in an epic battle.

[From [url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/The_Crown_%26_The_Flame,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你的敌人偷走了你的王国，但现在是你组建军队、掌握魔法并夺回王冠的时候了！

- 结成联盟来建立你的军队。
- 掌握独特的武器。
- 在优雅的舞会礼服和强大的盔甲之间进行选择。
- 在史诗般的战斗中粉碎你的敌人。

[来自[url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/The_Crown_%26_The_Flame,_Book_1]选择维基[/url]]
